Deep sea fishing off the Riviera Nayarit — there's nothing quite like it. 🎣

The waters around Sayulita and Punta de Mita are world-class fishing territory. Sailfish, mahi-mahi, yellowfin tuna, roosterfish — the Pacific here is generous to those who chase it.

Book a charter for a half or full day, head out at dawn, and let the crew show you exactly where the fish are running.

🐟 Sailfish & marlin offshore
🐠 Mahi-mahi & tuna in season
🚤 Local expert captains
🌅 Early morning departures
🍺 Cold beer on the way back

Not just fishing. An experience.

📍 Sayulita / Punta de Mita, Nayarit
